section.title_en: ✨ Build NPU Apps with Natural Language — dx-agentic-dev (Beta)
section.catchphrase_en: **One prompt → a working DX-M1 NPU app.** No boilerplate, no hand-rolled pipeline — an AI coding agent drives the DEEPX knowledge base end to end (brainstorm → plan → TDD → verify).
section.catchphrase_ko: **프롬프트 하나 → 동작하는 DX-M1 NPU 앱.** 보일러플레이트도, 손으로 짠 파이프라인도 없이 — AI 코딩 에이전트가 DEEPX 지식 베이스를 end-to-end로 구동(brainstorm → plan → TDD → verify).

showcases.name: squat-fitness-mini-game
showcases.what_en: Counts squat reps from knee/hip angles with an arcade HUD (reps / score / DOWN·UP·GOOD!).
showcases.what_ko: 무릎/엉덩이 각도로 스쿼트 횟수 카운트 + 아케이드 HUD(횟수 / 점수 / DOWN·UP·GOOD!).

showcases.name: stretching-coach-mini-game
showcases.what_en: Guides 3 stretches with an animated coach avatar that demonstrates each target pose.
showcases.what_ko: 애니메이션 coach 아바타가 각 목표 포즈를 시연하며 3가지 스트레칭 안내.

showcases.name: ultralytics-yolo-deepx-export
showcases.what_en: Turns an Ultralytics YOLO `.pt` into a deployable DeepX NPU model (`.dxnn`) in a single `yolo export ... format=deepx` command, then runs NPU inference + verify.
showcases.what_ko: Ultralytics YOLO `.pt`를 단일 `yolo export ... format=deepx` 명령으로 배포 가능한 DeepX NPU 모델(`.dxnn`)로 변환, NPU 추론 + verify.

showcases.name: ultralytics-retrain-eval-deepx-export-wildlife
showcases.what_en: Retrains `yolo26n` on `african-wildlife` (buffalo/elephant/rhino/zebra) for a safari/conservation camera; 4-way eval base/retrained × fp32/INT8.
showcases.what_ko: 사파리/보전 카메라용으로 `yolo26n`을 `african-wildlife`(buffalo/elephant/rhino/zebra)로 재학습; base/재학습 × fp32/INT8 4-way 평가.

showcases.name: ultralytics-retrain-eval-deepx-export-ppe
showcases.what_en: Retrains `yolo26n` on `construction-ppe` for a site-safety camera (helmet/vest/...); 4-way eval base/retrained × fp32/INT8.
showcases.what_ko: 현장 안전 카메라용으로 `yolo26n`을 `construction-ppe`(helmet/vest/...)로 재학습; base/재학습 × fp32/INT8 4-way 평가.

showcases.name: ultralytics-retrain-eval-deepx-export-braintumor
showcases.what_en: Retrains `yolo26n` on `brain-tumor` (MRI/CT) for a medical edge device; 4-way eval base/retrained × fp32/INT8.
showcases.what_ko: 의료 edge 디바이스용으로 `yolo26n`을 `brain-tumor`(MRI/CT)로 재학습; base/재학습 × fp32/INT8 4-way 평가.

showcases.name: ultralytics-retrain-eval-deepx-export-pills
showcases.what_en: Retrains `yolo26n` on `medical-pills` for a pharma counting station; 4-way eval base/retrained × fp32/INT8.
showcases.what_ko: 제약 카운팅 스테이션용으로 `yolo26n`을 `medical-pills`로 재학습; base/재학습 × fp32/INT8 4-way 평가.
